queries.title: Счётчик новых заявок
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = ?
queries.plan_after: SEARCH appointments USING COVERING INDEX idx_app_status (status=?)

queries.title: История заявок клиента по телефону
queries.sql: SELECT a.id, a.created_at, a.name, s.name FROM appointments a JOIN services s ON s.id = a.service_id WHERE a.phone = ? ORDER BY a.id DESC
queries.plan_before: SCAN a → SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
queries.plan_after: SEARCH a USING INDEX idx_app_phone (phone=?) → SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)

queries.title: Отчёт за месяц по услугам
queries.sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments a JOIN services s ON s.id = a.service_id WHERE a.created_at >= ? AND a.created_at < ? GROUP BY s.id
queries.plan_before: SCAN a → SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) → USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
queries.plan_after: SEARCH a USING COVERING INDEX idx_app_created_service (created_at>? AND created_at<?) → SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) → USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

queries.title: Страница №3001 списка заявок (50 на странице)
queries.sql: SELECT a.id, a.created_at, a.name FROM appointments a ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET ?  →  SELECT a.id, a.created_at, a.name FROM appointments a WHERE a.id < ? ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 50
queries.plan_after: SEARCH a USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid<?)

queries.title: Последние 50 заявок с названием услуги
queries.sql: 1 запрос + 50 запросов  →  один запрос с JOIN
